sentence: This project studies how a gene linked to autism disrupts sensory processing in the brain of a mouse model.
This project checks the purity of chemical resources and develops methods to detect drugs in plasma and tissues for research on organophosphate intoxication.
This project builds statistical methods that find hidden batches and biases in microbiome sequencing studies.
This project studies how a phosphoinositide kinase changes interferon signaling and the immune response to head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
This project studies how DNA-protein cross-links form and get repaired, and how an exonuclease helps repair DNA.
This project tests in mouse models whether a protein released from the liver during sepsis protects the heart from damage.
This project tests how combining epigenetics editing with immunotherapy changes the immune response against prostate cancer.
This project focuses on how the sequence of disordered proteins is linked to their function in health and disease.
This project develops a treatment that controls the immune system locally to keep transplanted corneas clear.
This project studies how the home and neighborhood surroundings of adolescents affect their sleep.
This project tries to find the neural circuits that control how the brain enters a sleep state.
This project studies how the cornea stays inflamed for years after an adenovirus infection of the eye.
This project studies a calcium channel in the heart that moves to the nucleus, and whether this can improve heart contractility.
This project studies how the kidneys control sodium transport to adjust fluids, electrolytes and blood pressure.
This project provides tools and shared resources for research on chronic kidney disease and acute kidney injury.
This project tests in mice how sleep and exercise change mutant cells in clonal hematopoiesis and atherosclerosis.
This project builds an AI model that explains its guidance on treatment choices using electronic health record data.
This project builds a technology that finds sequence variants in regulatory elements and shows how they change regulatory activity.
This project builds a computer model that predicts aneurysmal growth to help surgeons choose the right time for surgery.
